prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE full-body transparent visual novel game sprite by editing the supplied original project NAI master. Preserve EXACT same face proportions, eye color, hair silhouette/parting/accessories, costume, trim/buttons, socks/shoes and body proportions. Match its crisp variable ink contours, patterned hard cel shadows and subdued palette; no redesign or soft airbrush. New acting C09: flustered attempt to explain, uneven nervous mouth, one hand open to stop interruption, small sweat mark.  Entire body, top hair and both shoes inside empty transparent safe margins. One character only, anatomically correct hands. No scenery, glow, vignette, cast shadow, lettering, logos or furniture. No duplicate accessories, tools, weapons, fire or magic. Genuine transparent alpha outside silhouette. Portrait 1024x1536. Amber eyes. Notebook may be held CLOSED or pocketed; exactly one pink notebook, pocket pen and one attached rabbit keychain. Plain knee socks, no buckles.
origin: one NAI master per character; does not use rejected NAI pose candidates
actual_prompt_extra: Plain ribbed socks with no buckles or metal. Notebook closed and inside existing pocket, never hung from keychain. Keep safe space around head and feet.
